name: The Contempt of the Warp
description: Black Crusade, Table 6-6 (p. 227). Rolled when a Chaos ritual fails. Mechanical effects only - read the full description from the rulebook.

results.name: Ignored
results.text: The ritual fails, but the character is unharmed.

results.name: Struck Down
results.text: The character takes [[2d10]] Energy Damage with the Warp Weapon quality and gains [[1d10]] Corruption Points.

results.name: Assailed
results.text: A minor daemon or warp entity chosen by the GM appears, not subject to Mastery. If the ritual was a summoning, that daemon arrives instead - also free of Mastery - and attacks the summoner immediately.

results.name: Possessed
results.text: An Unclean Spirit or worse attempts to overthrow the character's mind. If the ritual was a summoning, that daemon is summoned free of Mastery and attempts to possess the summoner.
